summary: Frontend-only testing of three new Song Coder features: Edit/Delete Artists, Pin-to-top, and Lyrics Editor (Write + Sync modes). All scenarios in the review request passed end-to-end against the mock GitHub API at /api/mockgh. Also verified mobile layout at 390x844 and that regression (compose + reorder) still works.
critical_code_review_comments: songcoder.html has grown to 2098 lines; still single-file by design but is becoming hard to navigate. Consider splitting into modules (artists.js, lyrics.js, github.js, ui.js) in a future iteration.

The lyrics editor replaces blocks in place by matching data-track; if two different songs ever share a title the match is non-unique. Not reproducible in current seed, but worth tightening (match on title + artist-id).
Lyrics Write-mode textarea does not preserve times when user removes a line between modes — expected behavior per spec (times kept only on unchanged lines) but worth noting in docs.
test_credentials: Mock GitHub token: any non-empty string ('bad' => 401). API base: https://music-catalog-sync.preview.emergentagent.com/api/mockgh
seed_data_creation: POST /api/mockgh/reset at the start of each scenario group. For editing, changed artist #11 (Chelly Banqz) location to 'TEST City, GA'. For lyrics, added TEST explain + manual timestamps to Shake It Some Mo and new lyrics (incl. [Chorus]) to Bankrupt (Freestyle).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings must be entered via UI and saved with [data-testid=settings-save-btn] (localStorage key is 'treesh_songcoder_cfg_v2'); clicking only 'Test connection' does not persist cfg. Settings Save button is near the bottom of a right-side drawer – at viewport 1920x1080 the drawer save button is partially out of viewport, so use page.evaluate(... .click()) rather than Playwright click. Lyrics mode-toggle testids are 'lyrics-write-tab' and 'lyrics-sync-tab' (not 'lyrics-mode-write-btn'). Audio playback does not work headless; use direct DOM input of times via page.evaluate() setting .value + firing 'input','change' events (ElementHandle gets detached on re-render after each edit, so re-query). To parse lyric blocks from raw lyrics.html use a regex that reaches the OUTER (metadata is a nested div inside the lyric div).
